long_biography.plain_text:
Terranova began racing enduro in the late 1990s, winning four Argentine national titles before moving from motorcycles to cars. He became a regular at the Dakar Rally, taking stage victories and recording a career-best fourth place in 2022. His 2019 campaign with co-driver Ronnie Graue brought four wins from six events and the FIA World Cup for Cross-Country Bajas title.

His work off the course developed alongside the family's outdoor-advertising business, Publicidad Sarmiento, which he later served as president. He now heads OSD Group, the promoter of Argentina's MotoGP round and a past organizer of WorldSBK events. The group is also participating in plans to redevelop Buenos Aires's Oscar y Juan Galvez circuit for additional international racing.
